name: Ideogram
tagline: The AI image generator built specifically to get in-image text and typography right.
tldr: Ideogram is a text-to-image AI model that specializes in accurately rendering legible text inside generated images, an area where most competitors historically struggled.
Best for designers and marketers making posters, logos, packaging mockups, and marketing graphics where readable in-image text matters.
Reviewers cite roughly 90% text-rendering accuracy for Ideogram versus much lower success rates for general models like Midjourney on the same kind of prompts.
Offers a genuine free tier (10 slow credits/week, public images) plus paid Plus, Pro, and Team plans with priority credits that scale with price.
With the 2026 release of Ideogram 4.0, the platform has expanded beyond pure typography into broader design and creative image generation.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 10 slow credits/week, 1 concurrent generation, images public by default, includes commercial rights

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: 1,000 priority credits/month, 8 concurrent generations, private images

pros: Best-in-class accuracy for rendering legible text/typography inside generated images
Genuine free tier with no credit card required and commercial usage rights included
Strong prompt adherence for design-specific use cases like posters and branding
Ideogram 4.0 expanded quality and style range beyond its original text-focused niche
cons: Free tier images are public by default, which isn't suitable for confidential client work
Text rendering is far more reliable in English/Latin scripts than in CJK and other non-Latin languages
Some Trustpilot reviewers report a hidden or hard-to-find cancellation flow
Priority credits expire monthly with no rollover, similar to other credit-based competitors

sentiment.quote: A great program for making images for book covers, interior illustrations, and just about anything you can imagine - the sky's the limit on what you can produce.
Difficulties canceling membership, with the cancellation button being hidden.

bestFor: Designers creating posters, packaging, or branding that need readable in-image text
Marketers producing ad creative or social graphics with embedded copy
Users who want to try a capable model for free before subscribing
Teams needing private image generation with commercial rights
hotTake: Ideogram solved the one thing almost every other AI image generator still fumbles — legible text in the image itself — reportedly hitting around 90% accuracy versus Midjourney's roughly 30%.
